APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

18 oz stemmed glass

Yacht Parties ↗

An 18 oz acrylic stemmed bowl with a moulded foot: Look right on deck and survive a knock against the rail — the acrylic bowl takes it.

Outdoor Bars ↗

Chilled wine shows through the bowl, so it still reads as a proper glass.

Corporate Events & Branded Gifts ↗

Smart enough for a client dinner, at a fraction of glass cost.

Confirm for your project

Check deck grip, how stable the shape is and the operator's container rules；service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark；the printable area, what goes in the set and how it is packed.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
